info.title: REXRUN BP history forecast proposed research API
info.description: DESIGN ONLY. This route is not deployed or registered. Measurement analysis, lifestyle screening and forecasting have separate purposes. This prototype contract cannot authorize production numeric forecasts. A production schema and model registry gate require independent real-world validation and calibration.

post.summary: Reconstruct the authenticated owner's known history at a cutoff
post.description: Fetch server-owned revisions with measured_at and available_at at or before as_of. Do not accept subject_id, readings, model choice, clinical thresholds or v9 scores from the client. Bind owner to verified auth and explicit consent. Research access requires an additional server-controlled entitlement. Historical cutoffs must use the historical revision snapshot, not today's profile. Never send the full health history to a third-party model API.

as_of.description: Timezone-aware cutoff, not after server now. Prototype uses Asia/Seoul calendar days.

200.description: Research-only estimate or explicit abstention; abstention is not a negative diagnosis.

400.description: Invalid/future cutoff or invalid request. No values echoed in logs.

403.description: No health-data consent or no research entitlement.

409.description: Conflicting immutable revision or source reading. Preserve measurement display and repair data.

422.description: Unsupported timezone/contract. No silent date or unit conversion.

503.description: Server/model unavailable. Keep observed analysis available; do not substitute M1 screening probabilities.
